desc: Derive and validate the capped endpoint-pair counting formula for `L`, `R`, and `k`, including off-by-one details.
Derive monotonic-stack asymmetric boundary conventions for unique ownership of maxima and minima with duplicates.
Combine the boundaries and counting formula into a linear-time Python implementation of `Solution.minMaxSubarraySum`.
Verify against examples and edge cases: `k = 1`, `k = n`, all equal, monotone arrays, and negative values.
